// parallelizeTestCollections: All tests in this assembly spawn in-process brokers (BrokerFixture, BrokerSpawningCollection, or their own SurgewaveRuntime.CreateBuilder() calls). Running them in parallel means several brokers at once on random ports → on the GitHub Actions Linux runner (4 vCPUs) that hits port and process exhaustion and tests block. Locally, Windows has more headroom. Serial is slower, but the only robust option.
